import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import streamlit as st

st.title("Scenario Simulator")

with st.expander("About this page"):
    st.write(
        "Shows real before/after Land Surface Temperature predictions for candidate intervention sites, "
        "generated by the trained Physics-Residual Hybrid model. Full raster-level simulation via the InVEST "
        "Urban Cooling Model is planned once a validated land-cover classification is available; in the "
        "meantime, this page reports genuine per-site model predictions rather than placeholder data."
    )


@st.cache_data
def load_candidate_sites():
    return pd.read_csv("model/artifacts/candidate_intervention_sites.csv", encoding="utf-8")


candidates = load_candidate_sites()

with st.sidebar:
    st.header("Scenario Controls")
    zone = st.selectbox("Zone", candidates["zone"].unique().tolist())
    zone_sites = candidates[candidates["zone"] == zone]
    site_id = st.selectbox("Site", zone_sites["site_id"].tolist())

site = candidates[candidates["site_id"] == site_id].iloc[0]

st.subheader(f"{site['site_id']} — {site['zone']}")
st.caption(site["description"])

col1, col2, col3 = st.columns(3)
col1.metric("Baseline LST", f"{site['baseline_lst_c']:.2f} °C")
col2.metric("Post-intervention LST", f"{site['post_intervention_lst_c']:.2f} °C",
            delta=f"-{site['predicted_reduction_c']:.2f} °C")
col3.metric("Cost", f"{site['cost']:.1f}")

fig = go.Figure(data=[
    go.Bar(name="Baseline", x=["LST"], y=[site["baseline_lst_c"]], marker_color="#d62728"),
    go.Bar(name="Post-intervention", x=["LST"], y=[site["post_intervention_lst_c"]], marker_color="#2c7fb8"),
])
fig.update_layout(barmode="group", yaxis_title="°C", height=350, margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
st.plotly_chart(fig, use_container_width=True)

st.write(f"**Intervention:** {site['intervention']}")
st.write(f"**Cooling per unit cost:** {site['cooling_per_cost_ratio']:.3f} °C per cost unit")

st.divider()
st.subheader("All candidate sites in this zone")
st.dataframe(
    zone_sites[["site_id", "intervention", "baseline_lst_c", "post_intervention_lst_c", "predicted_reduction_c", "cost"]]
    .rename(columns={
        "site_id": "Site", "intervention": "Intervention",
        "baseline_lst_c": "Baseline (°C)", "post_intervention_lst_c": "Post (°C)",
        "predicted_reduction_c": "Reduction (°C)", "cost": "Cost",
    }),
    use_container_width=True, hide_index=True,
)
